title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Heroku-Architecture-Designer exam
question: Universal Containers runs an application in a Private Space in the Frankfurt region. The majority of the application's users (based in Asia) are reporting issues related to high latency. What should an Architect recommend to remediate this issue cost-effectively?
option_A: Add the Tokyo region to the existing Private Space. Update the application's configuration to move it to Tokyo region.
option_B: Deploy the application to the Common Runtime and select Tokyo as the region. Delete the existing Private Space.
option_C: Create an additional Private Space in the Tokyo region. Deploy an additional instance of the application to the region.
option_D: Create a new Private Space in the Tokyo Region, and deploy the application to the region. Delete the existing Private Space.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Heroku-Architecture-Designer exam
question:
A client runs an application on a background worker dyno. The application allows its users to request personalized information as a PDF. At peak usage, the app processes millions of requests at once. The resulting number of requests has caused a bottleneck that is impacting its performance.
Which two solutions can an Architect recommend to resolve the bottleneck and improve performance?
(Choose two.)
option_A: Increase the number of workers to consume the job faster.
option_B: Move the application to a Private Space.
option_C: Add a CDN add-on from the Elements marketplace.
option_D: Add Heroku Redis as a job queue.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Heroku-Architecture-Designer exam
question:
DreamHouse Realty has a data model as shown in the image. The Project object has a private sharing model, and it has Roll-Up summary fields to calculate the number of resources assigned to the project, total hours for the project, and the number of work items associated to the project.
There will be a large amount of time entry records to be loaded regularly from an external system into Salesforce.

What should the Architect consider in this situation?
option_A: Load all data using external IDs to link to parent records.
option_B: Calculate summary values instead of Roll-Up by using triggers.
option_C: Load all data after deferring sharing calculations.
option_D: Calculate summary values instead of Roll-Up by using workflow.

question: A client is writing a Heroku application that requires compliance with PCI DSS Level 1. To accomplish this, they deploy an application to the Shield Private Space. Which statement is true about the application?
option_A: The application might still violate PCI DSS Level 1 even though it is deployed to a Shield Private Space
option_B: The Shield Private Space guarantees that the application is compliant with PCI DSS Level 1, assuming the application uses only Shield Postgres databases
